name: Yuvraaj Bhatter
tagline: I build small, weird, delightful software — like a brain that grows out of your habits.
bio: Hi, I'm Yuvraaj — a software developer who likes making things that are a little too ambitious for a side project. Lately that's meant strapping SceneKit to a habit tracker (see: [Synapse](/blog/building-synapse/)) so my to-do list looks like a neuron growing synapses instead of a checklist. This site is where I write about that kind of thing, track what I'm building on GitHub, and log what I'm reading.
bioShort: Software developer. Currently growing a digital brain out of daily habits.
